environment: local Foundry EVM, no network or real funds
assertions: Bot-signed UserOperation and separately signed verifying-mode sponsorship execute through EntryPoint.handleOps.
Safe is the V6 pay ABI fixture payer; account value decreases by payment only and its EntryPoint deposit remains zero.
Pimlico sponsor deposit pays gas; UserOperationEvent binds operation hash, Safe, paymaster, success and gas.
Direct submissions cannot exceed payment budget, call count, fee bounds, expiry or sponsorship restrictions.
Wrong session signer and revoked session fail; owner revocation also advances enable-signature nonce.
Bot cannot replace fresh Safe owner signature; owner signature replay fails.
Failed inner execution emits success=false and consumes validation counters/sponsor gas.
Depleted sponsor deposit fails without account prefunding.
limitations: The V6 terminal is an explicit ABI/caller/value fixture, not deployed protocol code.
Pimlico constructor uses local fixture owner and signer keys; no hosted API credential, quote availability or production signer configuration is tested.
This is not a deployment, external audit or ERC-7562 bundler trace compliance certification.
